verdict: Approve for supported repository process ownership. No additional merge blocker found in the reviewed guard.

tests.mutation: Removing the immediate reservation check fails all three external-reap controls; 20 other cases deselected.

findings_resolved: An exit observer that raises ECHILD after an external waitpid cannot authorize killpg while Popen.returncode is still None.
Normal completion retains the unreaped leader until owned-descendant signalling; reaped-object and real external-reap paths refuse numeric signalling.
On Darwin the fallback validates both parent identity and expected process group before signalling.
limitations: The new check handles ownership already lost before that check. Arbitrary concurrent external waitpid/SIGCHLD reapers between the final check and signal are outside the supported synchronization model; this review does not certify them race-free.
No global SIGCHLD handler or waitpid(-1) reaper was found in repository source.
Independent execution covered Linux. The author supplied 23 passing Darwin cases, but this reviewer did not rerun Darwin.
This is an independent agent code review and test execution, not a GitHub approval by a different human account.
